name: Dirt Bike
description: A motor-powered vehicle with two or more tires, designed to travel over any terrain and capable of travelling off paved roads, whether or not it can be ridden legally on a street; one of Mississippi's off-road vehicles, with ATVs and recreational off-highway vehicles. Electric bicycles are excluded.

restrictions.rule: Two or more tires and designed to travel over any terrain, whether or not it may be ridden legally on a public street (Mississippi Code §63-31-3(5)(c))
No limit on motor power or speed (Mississippi Code §63-31-3(5)(c))
An electric bicycle is kept out of the off-road vehicle, dirt bike and ATV laws (Mississippi Code §63-31-3(5))

On public property, the rider needs a driver's license or a certificate from an off-road vehicle safety course taught through the Cooperative Extension Service or another organization the Department of Public Safety approves (Mississippi Code §63-31-3)
On public property, every rider and passenger under 16 must wear a helmet meeting FMVSS 218 (Mississippi Code §63-31-3)
The off-road vehicle law doesn't authorize riding it on a public road or highway (Mississippi Code §63-31-3)
